transcript.full_text: for the summer trip i suggest we drive up the coast and camp near the lighthouse. camping sounds great. i will bring the big tent and the portable stove. i can plan the hiking routes and book the campsite for the first weekend of august. then it is settled. coast drive, lighthouse camp, and the august hiking routes. i will also pack the fishing rods in case the campsite is near the water. and i will print the trail maps so we are not relying on phone signal.
